house_elena.name: Elena & Lila's Apartment
house_elena.description: A bright second-floor apartment with art on every wall and the smell of oil paint and coffee.

house_marcus.name: Marcus & Zoe's Place
house_marcus.description: A tidy apartment with workout equipment in the living room and Zoe's college textbooks stacked everywhere.

house_helen.name: Helen & Alice's Cottage
house_helen.description: A warm cottage with a flower garden, bookshelves, and the aroma of freshly baked cookies.

house_diana.name: Diana & Marco's House
house_diana.description: A practical family home above the grocery store. Marco's room is covered in game posters.

house_kai.name: Kai's Studio
house_kai.description: A small studio apartment crammed with musical instruments, vinyl records, and empty coffee cups.

house_priya.name: Priya & Nina's Flat
house_priya.description: A modern flat kept immaculately clean. Family photos on one side, property listings on the other.

house_james.name: James & Theo's House
house_james.description: A worn but comfortable house with a porch. Tools in the garage, beer in the fridge.

house_rosa.name: Rosa & Omar's Home
house_rosa.description: A cozy home that always smells of cooking. Spices from two continents line the kitchen shelves.

house_yuki.name: Yuki & Devon's Apartment
house_yuki.description: A minimalist apartment with a meditation corner on one side and newspaper clippings on the other.

house_frank.name: Frank, George & Sam's Row House
house_frank.description: A row of three connected units on the quiet end of the south side. Frank's garage is always open.

apartment_block_1.name: Northside Apartments
apartment_block_1.description: A modern four-story apartment building with a rooftop terrace and shared laundry room.

apartment_block_2.name: Southside Apartments
apartment_block_2.description: A brick apartment building with a courtyard garden and friendly neighbors who watch out for each other.

apartment_block_3.name: Central Apartments
apartment_block_3.description: A newly renovated building right off the town square. Convenient but noisy on weekends.

cafe.name: The Daily Grind
cafe.description: A warm, bustling cafe with mismatched furniture and the aroma of fresh coffee. The local gossip hub.

grocery.name: Green Basket Market
grocery.description: A neighborhood grocery store with fresh produce and a friendly owner who knows everyone by name.

bar.name: The Rusty Anchor
bar.description: A dimly lit bar with a jukebox, pool table, and regulars who've been coming for years. Lively at night.

restaurant.name: Mama Rosa's Kitchen
restaurant.description: A family-run Italian restaurant with checkered tablecloths and the best pasta in town.

bakery.name: Golden Crust Bakery
bakery.description: A charming bakery with a glass display of fresh pastries. The smell of bread draws people in from the street.

cinema.name: Starlight Cinema
cinema.description: A vintage two-screen cinema with red velvet seats and a popcorn machine that never stops.

office.name: The Hive Coworking
office.description: An open-plan coworking space with standing desks, meeting rooms, and a perpetually broken printer.

office_tower.name: Pinnacle Tower
office_tower.description: A sleek glass office building housing law firms, tech startups, and financial advisors across six floors.

factory.name: Ironworks Factory
factory.description: A large industrial building with a loading dock, welding bays, and the constant hum of machinery.

school.name: Soci Elementary & High
school.description: A two-story school building with a playground, science lab, and the sound of a bell every hour.

hospital.name: Soci City Hospital
hospital.description: A small community hospital with an ER, a few wards, and a cafeteria that serves surprisingly good soup.

park.name: Willow Park
park.description: A green park with old willow trees, a pond, benches, and a small playground. Popular for morning jogs and evening walks.

gym.name: Iron & Grit Gym
gym.description: A no-nonsense gym with free weights, treadmills, and a boxing ring in the back.

library.name: Soci Public Library
library.description: A quiet library with tall shelves, reading nooks, and a community board. Hosts book clubs and events.

church.name: St. Mary's Church
church.description: A stone church with stained glass windows, a quiet garden, and community gatherings every Sunday.

town_square.name: Town Square
town_square.description: The heart of Soci City. A cobblestone plaza with a fountain, benches, a notice board, and a weekend farmers market.

sports_field.name: Community Sports Field
sports_field.description: A large grassy field with soccer goals, a running track, and bleachers. Busy on evenings and weekends.

street_north.name: North Main Street
street_north.description: The main street running through the northern part of town. Shops, cafes, and foot traffic.

street_south.name: South Main Street
street_south.description: The southern stretch of main street. More residential, with the bar and gym nearby.

street_east.name: East Avenue
street_east.description: A quieter avenue on the east side of town, near the hospital and office towers.

street_west.name: West Avenue
street_west.description: A tree-lined avenue on the west side, near the school and sports fields.

apt_northeast.name: Eastview Terrace
apt_northeast.description: A modern apartment block in the northeast corner, popular with hospital staff and factory workers.

apt_northwest.name: Hilltop Gardens
apt_northwest.description: A quiet residential complex on the northwest hilltop, overlooking the school and church.

apt_southeast.name: Riverside Commons
apt_southeast.description: A lively apartment complex near the sports field and factory district, popular with young workers.

apt_southwest.name: Orchard Hill Flats
apt_southwest.description: A peaceful residential block on the southwest edge of town, close to the library and park.

diner.name: Blue Moon Diner
diner.description: A classic diner open early to late. Strong coffee, big plates, and regulars who treat it like a second home.

pharmacy.name: SociMed Pharmacy
pharmacy.description: A neighborhood pharmacy where the pharmacist knows everyone by name and stocks good candy.

persona.name: Elena Vasquez
persona.background: Elena moved to Soci City two years ago after a burnout at a big tech company. She now freelances and values work-life balance. She grew up in a large family and misses the closeness but enjoys her independence. She shares an apartment with Lila, her artist roommate.
quirks: always orders the same coffee (oat milk latte)
sketches in a notebook when thinking
persona.communication_style: thoughtful and slightly nerdy, uses analogies

life_events.description: Born and raised. Zoe is Marcus's younger sister, home from college for the semester after a rough breakup. She's figuring out what she wants from life. She's passionate about social justice but can be self-righteous. She idolizes her brother.
Works as college student (home for the semester)

goals.description: Graduate and find a career

persona.name: Helen Park
persona.background: Helen taught high school English for 35 years and retired last spring. She's adjusting to the slower pace. Her husband passed three years ago, and she fills her days with reading, gardening, and volunteering at the library. She shares her cottage with her closest friend Alice.

life_events.description: Born and raised. Helen taught high school English for 35 years and retired last spring. She's adjusting to the slower pace. Her husband passed three years ago, and she fills her days with reading, gardening, and volunteering at the library. She shares her cottage with her closest friend Alice.
Works as retired teacher

goals.description: Build a stable and happy life

persona.name: Alice Fontaine
persona.background: Alice retired early and now spends her time perfecting baking recipes. She dreams of opening a small bakery. She lives with Helen and they have tea together every afternoon. She's steady, reliable, and the person everyone calls in a crisis.
quirks: keeps a mental spreadsheet of everyone's dietary needs
persona.communication_style: steady and cheerful, uses baking analogies, good at calming people down

persona.name: Diana Novak
persona.background: Diana took over Green Basket Market from her father five years ago. She works long hours and worries about competition from big chains. She's a single mother with a teenage son Marco and is fiercely protective of her store.
persona.communication_style: practical and direct, occasionally sharp under stress

Their parents disapprove, which is a constant source of stress. They're talented but undisciplined. They live alone in a tiny studio apartment.

persona.background: Priya is an overworked doctor who moved here for the quiet neighborhood. She feels guilty about not spending enough time with her two young kids. She's kind but stretched thin and sometimes snappy when exhausted. She shares a flat with Nina.
persona.communication_style: precise and caring, clinical when stressed, warm when relaxed

life_events.description: Born and raised. Priya is an overworked doctor who moved here for the quiet neighborhood. She feels guilty about not spending enough time with her two young kids. She's kind but stretched thin and sometimes snappy when exhausted. She shares a flat with Nina.
Works as doctor (works at a clinic outside the city, spends free time locally)

goals.description: Find meaningful relationships
Build a stable and happy life

persona.name: Nina Volkov
persona.background: Nina is ambitious and sharp. She moved to Soci City to scout development opportunities. Some residents distrust her motives — is she here to gentrify? She's not evil, just driven. She genuinely likes the community but struggles to show it past her professional veneer.
quirks: knows property values of every building
persona.communication_style: polished and assertive, networking mode, occasionally lets guard down

life_events.description: Born and raised. Rosa opened Mama Rosa's Kitchen 25 years ago with recipes from her nonna. She's the heart of the community and feeds people even when they can't pay. Her children have moved away, which makes her sad, but the restaurant is her life. She lives with Omar, who helps in her kitchen.
Works as restaurant owner and chef

goals.description: Build a stable and happy life

persona.name: Omar Hassan
persona.background: Omar immigrated fifteen years ago and built a life from nothing. He drives a taxi during the day and sometimes helps Rosa in the kitchen. He's philosophical and loves debating politics at the bar. He sends money to family back home. He lives with Rosa and they share cooking duties.
quirks: knows every shortcut in the city
persona.communication_style: warm and philosophical, uses proverbs, debates passionately but respectfully

life_events.description: Born and raised. Omar immigrated fifteen years ago and built a life from nothing. He drives a taxi during the day and sometimes helps Rosa in the kitchen. He's philosophical and loves debating politics at the bar. He sends money to family back home. He lives with Rosa and they share cooking duties.
Works as taxi driver and part-time cook

persona.name: Yuki Tanaka
persona.background: Yuki moved from Tokyo two years ago seeking a quieter life. She teaches yoga at the gym and does private massage sessions. She's deeply empathetic and people naturally confide in her. She shares an apartment with Devon.
quirks: offers breathing exercises to stressed people
persona.communication_style: gentle and calming, uses nature imagery, occasionally profound

life_events.description: Born and raised. Yuki moved from Tokyo two years ago seeking a quieter life. She teaches yoga at the gym and does private massage sessions. She's deeply empathetic and people naturally confide in her. She shares an apartment with Devon.
Works as yoga instructor and massage therapist

goals.description: Advance in my career
Find meaningful relationships

persona.name: Devon Reeves
persona.background: Devon is an investigative journalist who moved to Soci City following a lead that went nowhere. He stayed because he likes the community. He's always looking for the next story and can be pushy. He has trust issues from his work. He shares an apartment with Yuki.
persona.communication_style: probing and articulate, sometimes intense, asks follow-up questions

persona.name: Sam Nakamura
persona.background: Sam runs the Soci Public Library with quiet devotion. They're non-binary and moved here five years ago seeking a more accepting community. They host book clubs, poetry nights, and secretly write science fiction novels.
quirks: speaks in whispers even outside the library
persona.communication_style: soft-spoken and precise, literary references, dry humor
